stem: Kavya starts with a dough ball of mass 50 g. Each rise doubles the current mass. She wants the mass after n rises.

parts.text: Which claim models the mass correctly?

options.text: Start at 50 g and multiply by 2 at each rise.
Start at 50 g and add 2 g at each rise.
Multiply the starting 50 g by n only.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Doubling acts on the current mass each time, so the model is repeated multiplication by 2, not adding 2 or multiplying only by n.

teacher.key_rationale: Each rise multiplies the current mass by 2. Adding 2 treats growth as repeated addition. Multiplying by n alone drops the repeated doubling.
